name: BoundingSieve
siftedSum_le_mainSum_errSum_of_upperMoebius
result.signature: (muPlus : ℕ → ℝ) (h : IsUpperMoebius muPlus) : s.siftedSum ≤ s.totalMass * s.mainSum muPlus + s.errSum muPlus
result.type:
∀ {s : BoundingSieve} (muPlus : ℕ → ℝ),
  BoundingSieve.IsUpperMoebius muPlus →
    BoundingSieve.siftedSum ≤ s.totalMass * BoundingSieve.mainSum muPlus + BoundingSieve.errSum muPlus
result.value:
:=
  calc
    s.siftedSum ≤ ∑ d ∈ divisors s.prodPrimes, muPlus d * multSum d := siftedSum_le_sum_of_upperMoebius _ h
    _ = s.totalMass * mainSum muPlus + ∑ d ∈ divisors s.prodPrimes, muPlus d * s.rem d :=
      by
      rw [mainSum, mul_sum, ← sum_add_distrib]
      congr with d
      dsimp only [rem]; ring
    _ ≤ s.totalMass * mainSum muPlus + errSum muPlus := by
      rw [errSum]
      gcongr _ + ∑ d ∈ _, ?_ with d
      rw [← abs_mul]
      exact le_abs_self (muPlus d * s.rem d)
result.informal_name: Upper Möbius Bound for Sifted Sum in Selberg Sieve
result.informal_description: For any function $\mu_+: \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}$ satisfying the upper Möbius condition (i.e., $\sum_{d \mid n} \mu_+(d) \geq 1$ for $n=1$ and $\geq 0$ otherwise), the sifted sum of a bounding sieve $s$ satisfies the inequality $\text{siftedSum}(s) \leq \text{totalMass}(s) \cdot \text{mainSum}(\mu_+, s) + \text{errSum}(\mu_+, s)$, where $\text{mainSum}$ and $\text{errSum}$ are sums over divisors of the sieve's prime product involving $\mu_+$, the sieve's arithmetic function $\nu_s$, and residual terms.

result.value:
:=
  by
  simp only [Function.support, ne_eq, div_eq_zero_iff, ite_eq_right_iff, Set.indicator_apply_eq_zero, Set.mem_setOf_eq,
    Nat.cast_eq_zero, not_or, Classical.not_imp]
  ext1 p
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  exact ⟨fun H ↦ ⟨H.1.1, H.1.2.1⟩, fun H ↦ ⟨⟨H.1, H.2, vonMangoldt_ne_zero_iff.mpr H.1.isPrimePow⟩, H.1.ne_zero⟩⟩
result.informal_name: Support of Von Mangoldt Function in Residue Class $ a \mod q $ Equals Primes in That Class
result.informal_description: The support of the function defined by $ \Lambda(n)/n $ if $ n $ is a prime congruent to $ a $ modulo $ q $, and 0 otherwise, is the set of all primes $ p $ such that $ p \equiv a \mod q $. This characterizes the primes in the residue class $ a \mod q $ as precisely those where the function does not vanish.

name: BoundingSieve
siftedSum_eq_sum_support_mul_ite
result.signature: : s.siftedSum = ∑ d ∈ s.support, s.weights d * if Nat.gcd s.prodPrimes d = 1 then 1 else 0
result.type: ∀ {s : BoundingSieve}, BoundingSieve.siftedSum = ∑ d ∈ s.support, s.weights d * if s.prodPrimes.gcd d = 1 then 1 else 0
result.value:
:= by
  dsimp only [siftedSum]
  simp_rw [mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero]
result.informal_name: Sifted Sum Equals Weighted Sum with Coprimality Condition
result.informal_description: For a bounding sieve $ s $, the sifted sum $ s.siftedSum $ is equal to the sum over all $ d $ in the support of $ s $ of $ s.weights(d) $ multiplied by $ 1 $ if $ \gcd(s.prodPrimes, d) = 1 $, and $ 0 $ otherwise. Symbolically, $ s.siftedSum = \sum_{d \in s.support} s.weights(d) \cdot \begin{cases} 1 & \text{if } \gcd(s.prodPrimes, d) = 1, \\ 0 & \text{otherwise}. \end{cases} $

name: BoundingSieve
nu_pos_of_dvd_prodPrimes
result.type: ∀ {s : BoundingSieve} {d : ℕ}, d ∣ s.prodPrimes → 0 < s.nu d
result.value:
:= by
  calc
    0 < ∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, s.nu p := by
      apply prod_pos
      intro p hpd
      have hp_prime : p.Prime := prime_of_mem_primeFactors hpd
      have hp_dvd : p ∣ s.prodPrimes := (dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hpd).trans hd
      exact s.nu_pos_of_prime p hp_prime hp_dvd
    _ = s.nu d := prod_primeFactors_nu hd
result.informal_name: Positivity of the ν-Function for Divisors of the Prime Product in Selberg Sieve
result.informal_description: For any natural number $ d $ such that $ d $ divides the product of primes associated with a bounding sieve $ s $, the arithmetic function $ \nu_s(d) $ satisfies $ \nu_s(d) > 0 $.
